actions_signed_has_hash_and_nonce.name: actions_signed_has_hash_and_nonce
actions_signed_has_hash_and_nonce.value: "actions"."status" = 'planned' or "actions"."status" = 'never_landed' or ("actions"."tx_hash" is not null and "actions"."nonce" is not null)

approvals_answer_is_complete.name: approvals_answer_is_complete
approvals_answer_is_complete.value: ("approvals"."status" in ('approved', 'rejected')) = ("approvals"."answered_by" is not null and "approvals"."answered_at" is not null and "approvals"."answered_via" is not null)

mandates_bps_in_range.name: mandates_bps_in_range
mandates_bps_in_range.value: "mandates"."drift_tolerance_bps" between 0 and 10000 and "mandates"."max_position_bps" between 0 and 10000 and "mandates"."loss_stop_bps" between 0 and 10000

cash_flows_is_traceable.name: cash_flows_is_traceable
cash_flows_is_traceable.value: "cash_flows"."tx_hash" is not null or "cash_flows"."relay_request_id" is not null
